rules.exploit: Connect to the FTP service as anonymous and access files exposed through the anonymous FTP account.
Authenticate to the FTP service and upload or modify files permitted by the configured FTP account.

rules.description: vsftpd permits anonymous users to upload files.
rules.exploit: Connect anonymously and upload an attacker-controlled file to the configured anonymous FTP upload location.

rules.description: vsftpd permits anonymous users to create directories.
rules.exploit: Connect anonymously and create directories in the writable anonymous FTP location.

rules.description: FTP configuration permits or references direct root authentication.
rules.exploit: Attempt authentication to the FTP service using authorized root credentials and determine whether direct privileged access is permitted.
